Does This Market Have the Juice to Retest Its Highs? By 0
The market is presently undergoing its fourth bounce since it hit a top in late January. The first bounce in February was the most powerful but it failed at the end of February with a drop of nearly 4%. The next try resulted in a higher high, but the subsequent failure was even worse and the early February lows were retested.
In April another bounce ensued but that lacked the power of the previous two and fizzled out as concerns about the poor reaction to earnings season took place.
